newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Turkey says will block WEU use of NATO equipment.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says will block WEU use of NATO equipment.

text.p: Turkish Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller said on Tuesday her country would block the use of NATO equipment by the Western European Union because of Greek objections to Ankara's participation in WEU actions.
"Turkey will block all the support of NATO...," she told Turkish reporters. "The WEU can do nothing without the support of NATO."
A Turkish journalist who attended Ciller's news conference said she had been very angry and left for Ankara immediately afterwards.
He said Ciller had said Greece did not want Turkey, an associate member of the WEU, to participate in WEU activities such as peacekeeping and humanitarian aid.
The WEU relies on NATO for equipment for such activities and as a member of NATO Turkey can block this equipment from being used.
